item.title: Opinion: California schools that ban cellphones make students want them more
item.description: Blanket bans can punish students who use phones responsibly and may worsen overuse by making phones more tempting. They can also shift screentime to before or after class, when schools have less oversight. item.title: Why one of North Carolina’s top school districts is eyeing closures
item.description: The Chapel Hill-Carrboro school board is considering closing up to two elementary schools as enrollment declines and budget pressures grow.
